coverage.summary: Residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits; operates alongside state antitrust laws rather than replacing them.

evidence.quoted_span: Defines a limited scope, covering residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits;
The new algorithmic rent-setting ordinance is limited to residential rental property
It is structured to operate alongside existing and proposed state antitrust laws while providing stronger local protections

result.notes:
I set other_conditions to null. The exclusions it listed (software relying solely on public or aggregate historical data, and affordable-housing compliance tools) describe the software a landlord uses, not buildings, units or owners. They remain recorded in the rule's exemptions field.

I rewrote the summary to remove two things. First, the list of sellers, licensors, providers and users, which describes conduct. Second, the Cartwright Act / Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729 reference, which none of the documents support. The summary now says only that the rule operates alongside state antitrust laws, per DX19.

I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule covers ordinary residential rental property citywide. No building-level size, age or owner conditions appear in the documents.

All scope evidence comes from a press-release description of the first-reading version (DX19); the adopted text may differ.
